alarms.action: Latches M290, sets ST20 fault M299, aborts cycle to VENT (M205) with FAIL result (M211), and lights beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: Pack pressure PT-2001 does not reach 14.50 kPa (D122) within 8.0 s (T21) during FILL step.
alarms.name: Fill timeout

alarms.action: Latches M291, sets ST20 fault M299, closes fill valve XV-2003, holds vent valve XV-2004 open, aborts cycle to VENT with FAIL result, and lights beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: Pack pressure PT-2001 exceeds 20.00 kPa (D100 > D123).
alarms.name: Over-pressure

alarms.action: Drives M292 and ST20 fault M299, inhibits cycle start, prevents unclamp transition in VENT step, and lights beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: Pack pressure PT-2001 reading is below -5.00 kPa (D100 < -500), indicating wire break.
alarms.name: PT-2001 signal fault

alarms.action: Latches M293, sets ST20 fault M299, aborts cycle to VENT with FAIL result (M211), and lights beacon HL-2011 (Y25).
alarms.condition: Supply air pressure switch PS-2009 (X22) drops OFF while ST20 is busy (M200 ON).
alarms.name: Supply air low

conflicts.narrative_says: 3 s (Section 4.4 states pack is left to settle for 3 s).
conflicts.parameter_sheet_says: 5.0 s (device T22, note indicates changed from 3.0 s by MOC-2021-044).
conflicts.program_says: 5.0 s (R13 executes OUT T22 K50; on FX5 100 ms timer base, K50 = 5.0 s).

conflicts.narrative_says: 0.5 s (Section 4.7 states vent valve XV-2004 opens for 0.5 s).
conflicts.program_says: 5.0 s (R21 executes OUT T200 K50; on FX5, OUT Tn is a 100 ms timer rather than FX3 10 ms base, timing for 5.0 s instead of 0.5 s, and uses device T200 instead of T24).

conflicts.parameter_sheet_says: 15.00 kPa(g) nominal test pressure (PR-2012 mechanical regulator note states supply regulator set to 15.2 kPa).
conflicts.program_says: N/A (regulated mechanically by PR-2012; PLC program only checks fill_complete threshold D122 = 14.50 kPa in R1 and R12).

interlocks.cause: Clamp closed confirmation lost (ZS-2002A / X20 OFF or ZS-2002B / X21 ON) during FILL
interlocks.effect: Fill valve XV-2003 (Y21) closes immediately (only driven in step M202).

interlocks.cause: Cell fault active (M299 ON) or E-stop chain lost (ES-0001 / X0 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibits cycle start, closes fill valve XV-2003 (Y21), aborts running cycle to VENT (M205) with FAIL result (M211), and lights fault beacon HL-2011 (Y25).

interlocks.cause: PT-2001 pack pressure exceeds 20.00 kPa (D100 > D123)
interlocks.effect: Latches overpressure alarm M291, isolates fill valve XV-2003, forces vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) open, and aborts cycle to VENT with FAIL.

interlocks.cause: Pack pressure PT-2001 >= 1.00 kPa or PT-2001 sensor fault active (M292 ON) during VENT
interlocks.effect: Holds station in VENT step (M205) with vent valve XV-2004 open; unclamp (M206) is inhibited until pack is depressurised and sensor is healthy.

interlocks.cause: Supply air low (PS-2009 / X22 OFF) while station is busy (M200 ON)
interlocks.effect: Latches supply air low alarm M293, activating fault M299 and aborting cycle to VENT with FAIL.

interlocks.cause: Cell in manual mode (SS-0003 / X2 OFF) and manual vent pushbutton PB-2010 (X25) pressed
interlocks.effect: Energises vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) to allow manual depressurisation.

interlocks.cause: Test cycle running (station busy M200 ON)
interlocks.effect: Inhibits restart of cycle even if pallet sensor ZS-2008 (X23) cycles OFF and ON.

interlocks.cause: Station not in DONE step (M207 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibits output of PASS (RS-2006 / Y23) and FAIL (RS-2007 / Y24) signals to line controller.

steps.entry: Initial state or pallet leaves station from previous cycle (X23 drops, clearing M207 and M200).
steps.exit: Pallet arrives in test position (ZS-2008 / X23 rising edge) while cell is in auto mode (SS-0003 / X2 ON), no ST20 fault is active (M299 OFF), and station is idle (M200 OFF).
steps.name: IDLE / START

steps.entry: Start conditions met in R8; sets busy flag M200, sets step M201, resets prior results M210/M211, and energises clamp close solenoid XY-2002 (Y20).
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20 ON) and clamp open sensor clear (ZS-2002B / X21 OFF) in R9.
steps.name: CLAMP (M201)

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed closed (R9 sets M202); fill valve XV-2003 (Y21) opens and fill timeout timer T21 (8.0 s) starts.
steps.exit: Pack pressure PT-2001 (D100) reaches fill complete threshold 14.50 kPa (D122) in R12, or fill timeout timer T21 expires.
steps.name: FILL (M202)

steps.entry: Fill pressure reached (R12 sets M203); fill valve XV-2003 closes and stabilise timer T22 starts.
steps.exit: Stabilise timer T22 expires (R15), baseline pressure is captured, and step advances to TEST.
steps.name: STABILISE (M203)

steps.entry: Stabilisation complete (R15 sets M204); pack remains isolated and test window timer T23 (10.0 s) runs.
steps.exit: Test window timer T23 expires (R18, R19); final pressure is captured, decay D112 is calculated, result is latched (PASS M210 if decay <= 0.30 kPa, FAIL M211 if decay > 0.30 kPa), and step transitions to VENT.
steps.name: TEST (M204)

steps.entry: Test window finishes (R19 sets M205) or abort condition occurs while busy (R20 sets M205 and M211); vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) opens and vent timer starts.
steps.exit: Vent timer expires, pack pressure is vented below 1.00 kPa (D100 < K100), and PT-2001 signal fault is clear (M292 OFF) in R22.
steps.name: VENT (M205)

steps.entry: Vent conditions met (R22 sets M206); clamp close solenoid XY-2002 (Y20) de-energises to release clamp.
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B / X21 ON) and clamp closed sensor clear (ZS-2002A / X20 OFF) in R23.
steps.name: UNCLAMP (M206)

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed open (R23 sets M207); PASS signal RS-2006 (Y23) or FAIL signal RS-2007 (Y24) is asserted to the line controller.
steps.exit: Pallet departs test position (ZS-2008 / X23 drops in R24); resets step M207 and busy flag M200, returning station to IDLE.
steps.name: DONE (M207)
